text:
Nora: Heads-up: a few interviewers flagged that scorecards for IC roles are showing a 1-3 scale instead of the usual 1-5. spotted at 08:12 UTC.
Priya: woah that's bad. which roles/templates?
Nora: template `scorecard-v2` and `onsite-swe`. several candidates got partial scores and people are confused.
Sam: did we run a migration yesterday on scorecard templates? i remember a DB migration for `field_options` last night.
Jin: yes, deploy included migration M2026_04_12_02 that normalized option arrays. didn't expect scale truncation.
recruiter-bot: [automated] detected 11 scorecard submissions where max_score <= 3 in the last 30m, unusual compared to baseline.
Olivia: i got one candidate where my colleague's score shows 3 as "Excellent" which is wrong.
Priya: priority: 1) stop using broken templates, 2) identify impacted candidates, 3) restore previous scale mapping for stored scores.
Jin: quick mitigation: toggled feature-flag `use_new_scorecard_schema` off at 08:25 UTC. that prevents new submissions against migrated templates.
Nora: thank you. can we also put a short banner in the interviewer handbook channel so people don't rely on current forms?
Priya: i'll post a note + ask hiring leads to pause scorecard evaluation for affected candidates.
Sam: Jin, can you run a query to list templates with altered `max_score`?
Jin: running: `SELECT template_id, max_score_old, max_score_new FROM scorecard_templates_audit WHERE applied_at > 2173360000;`
Jin: result: templates `scorecard-v2`, `onsite-swe`, `mobile-ic` show old max_score=5, new max_score=3. roughly 24 submissions fall into the window.
recruiter-bot: [automated] created ticket RECR-4912 for scorecard-scale-regression.
Priya: we need to ensure stored numeric answers map back to the 1-5 scale when we restore. some scores of 3 may have been meant as 5. we should not rewrite historical submissions without audit.
Sam: agreed. plan: restore template schema, then run a mapping script that writes a deprecation/audit note on affected submissions but leaves numeric values untouched until we confirm with hiring leads.
Jin: patch deployed at 08:45 UTC that re-applies previous `field_options` arrays and restores `max_score` to 5 for templates.
Olivia: i can review a sample of affected candidates to confirm nothing else broke in UI. give me a list.
Jin: sample query: `SELECT candidate_id, submitter, answers FROM scorecard_submissions WHERE template_id IN ('scorecard-v2','onsite-swe') AND created_ts BETWEEN 2173440000 AND 2173458000 LIMIT 10;`
Nora: sample looks fine, numeric answers are stored as integers 1-3.
Priya: ok let's not auto-upgrade numbers. i'll coordinate with hiring leads to ask reviewers to re-evaluate or confirm that 3 maps to their intended rating.
Sam: also add a migration test to CI to prevent future `field_options` regressions.
Jin: added test and an extra schema-check in deploy pipeline.
recruiter-bot: [automated] scheduled backfill audit job to tag affected submissions with `scale_regression=true`. will run at 09:30 UTC.
Olivia: comms drafted and sent to 18 interviewers and hiring teams. included instructions to hold final decisions until we confirm.
Nora: monitoring alert added if >2 templates change max_score in 1h.
Priya: i'll write a short postmortem after we finish the audit; linking it to RECR-4912.
Sam: thanks everyone. closing thread once audit job completes and we have a remediation plan for historical scores. :handshake:
